itemList.description: The Dream Slide Illuminated Unicorn Edition is a beautifully crafted, child friendly play structure designed to blend fantasy with function. Ideal for children, Localites, Visitores Foriegners, it features a pastel rainbow color palette with soft hues of pink, lavender, sky blue, and yellow. A charming unicorn fgure crowns the top of the slide, complete with a glittery horn, sculpted a fowing tail. Enhancing the magical appeal, the slide is embedded with multi color RGB LED lights along the surface and edges, offering four dynamic lighting modes steady glow, rainbow fade, sparkle pulse, and night glow as shown in the image. These lights are powered by a USB rechargeable battery with a 6 to 8 hour runtime and are operated via a convenient remote control or integrated touch panel. Constructed from high density, non toxic polyethylene, the slide ensures both durability and safety, featuring anti slip steps, high side railings, and smooth, rounded edges. It meets international safety standards with EN71 and ASTM certifcations and is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use though the electronic components should be protected from rain. The structure supports a weight capacity of up to 50 kg (110 lbs) and is designed for tool-free, snap-together assembly for quick setup. Each unit includes a unicorn-themed play mat, decorative rainbow streamers, and a one year limited warranty. With its engaging design and practical build, the Dream Slide offers not just a toy, but a truly magical play experience making it a standout attraction for events in 2025 Dasara Exhibition. Fixing, maintenance from inauguration of Exhibition2025 to end of the Exhibition2025.
